comparison.control_a: saved F3-C branch A with original unconstrained search; no rerun
comparison.candidate_e1: same branch A representation with nested log/sqrt constraints

nested_constraint_semantics: zero forbids the named inner operator anywhere under the named outer operator
selection: complete validation RMSE per run with exact saved-A and formal-F1 fallbacks

acceptance_rules_predeclared_before_sear.full_validation: E1 three-seed median RMSE must be strictly below saved A
acceptance_rules_predeclared_before_sear.curve_behavior: E1 median curve-mean and worst-curve RMSE must both be strictly below saved A
acceptance_rules_predeclared_before_sear.target_region: E1 median 1300-2000 Hz RMSE must be strictly below saved A
acceptance_rules_predeclared_before_sear.guardrails: E1 may not worsen more than 10% versus saved A in any declared region, both by median and matched seed
acceptance_rules_predeclared_before_sear.constraint_compliance: every Hall-of-Fame and selected equation must obey the frozen nesting constraint
acceptance_rules_predeclared_before_sear.fallbacks: every E1 candidate set includes exact saved-A and zero-residual formal-F1 fallbacks

guardrail_control: matched saved F3-C branch A result
test_access_contract: test features, targets, and predictions remain inaccessible
